children: On October 15, 2026, Nasdaq notified Stardust Power that its common stock and warrants would be delisted after the stock's closing bid price was $0.10 or less for ten consecutive trading days, under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5810(c)(3)(A)(iii). Trading was suspended on October 23, and Nasdaq announced on November 23 that it would proceed with delisting; the securities are now quoted on the OTC Pink Limited Market as SDST and SDSTW.
